name: New Jersey: Uniform Construction Code, One- and Two-Family Dwelling Subcode (IRC 2024, New Jersey edition)

review.note: Adopts IRC 2024 (NJ Department of Community Affairs, Division of Codes and Standards; N.J.A.C. 5:23-3.21). State amendments to the checked rules: riser height, tread depth.
